investigation_notes.Description: Website vitalis-hr-benefits.com (IP 192.185.112.40) was detected displaying the Vitalis Healthcare logo and a payroll login form that closely mimics the legitimate service, consistent with brand impersonation and credential harvesting. The domain was registered roughly five hours prior and the scanned URL is distinct from the official vitalis.com domain, increasing the likelihood this is a malicious phishing site. Because a credential collection form is present on a newly created domain that imitates the corporate login, this activity is assessed as a high-risk incident that requires further investigation.
